title: Another way to find the right hiring manager to follow up with...
description:
After you’ve applied to a job the next step is to follow up…but what if you don’t know who to follow up with? Here’s another tip to finding the right person. Head to LinkedIn and look up the company, then click “people” then filter in the title of Recruiter. Do keep in mine all layoffs going on it’s understandable people might not immediately removing companies from their profile. #jobapplication #jobapplications #jobapplicationtips
